claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the engine but provides no test video, compression/leak test results, sound recording, or mileage/engine history proof.

risks.risk: Engine identity mismatch (not actually the claimed LX460/Lexus engine). One photo doesn’t show the engine code/ID.
risks.proof: Ask for a close-up photo of the engine identification plate/stamping (engine code) and the full engine label area, plus a photo showing the engine code clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic used engine assembly with unknown condition (worst case: not proven working).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” may be untrue or unverified; could have internal wear not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Ask for a short video of the engine running (cold start if possible) with audio, plus a compression test/leak-down report screenshot.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: may need overhaul).

risks.risk: “Never opened” may be false; could have been rebuilt or opened previously.
risks.proof: Ask for photos of the cylinder head cover area, timing cover area, and any sealant marks/fastener condition (close-ups).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially opened/unknown history (worst case: treat as used/possibly rebuilt).

risks.risk: Completeness risk: engine may be missing key parts (sensors, alternator, starter, wiring harness sections, intake/exhaust pieces).
risks.proof: Ask for a checklist photo: show all accessories included (starter, alternator, alternator bracket, sensors, coils, intake manifold, exhaust manifold, wiring harness connectors).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: buyer may need to source missing parts).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code/ID stamping/plate (clearly readable) and where it is located on the engine.
Video of the engine running with audio (showing no knock) and ideally a cold start.
Compression test or leak-down test results (screenshots or paper with clear readings).
Photos showing key areas to confirm “never opened” (timing cover/sealant marks, cylinder head cover area).
A parts-included checklist with photos of all accessories/sensors/harness connectors included.
response.reason: From the single photo, the exact engine identity (to match LX460/Lexus engine) and the seller’s “tested/working/no knock/low mileage/never opened” claims cannot be verified remotely, so a safe worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct engine type.
